instructions: Each event requires utcISO (UTC timestamp ending Z), kind, source, result and code. elapsedSeconds is optional; omit it when the observer monotonic baseline is unknown and do not derive it from header UTC. Use only the declared enumerations. Do not add free-text notes, prompts, filenames, paths, addresses, account details or payloads. Keep events empty until real annotations exist; an empty array means no annotations were provided, not no activity.
